articles.summary: Paces is launching two new tools, Transmission Line Reports and Injection Studies, that let renewable energy developers and utilities assess grid transmission feasibility and forecast interconnection costs in days instead of months. By surfacing this data earlier, teams can compare sites, avoid costly late-stage surprises, and make faster, better-informed capital decisions.
articles.title: Paces Introduces Transmission Line Reports and Injection Studies for Faster, More Informed Site Decisions

articles.summary: The first Paces Accelerate webinar explored how development teams can better understand interconnection requirements, timelines, costs, and project-specific exposure before committing capital.
articles.title: Interconnection Pathways: What Developers Need to Know Before Filing
